newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil posts net dlr inflows of $815 mln in June.
newsitem.headline: Brazil posts net dlr inflows of $815 mln in June.

text.p: Brazil's commercial and financial foreign exchange transactions showed a preliminary surplus of $815 million in June in the forex commercial market, against a $1.803 billion surplus in May, the Central Bank said.
It was the lowest surplus this year, partially due to a large number of payments on Eurobond obligations, dealers said.
Financial buy deals totalled $9.217 billion in June, according to Central Bank. Financial sell operations amounted to $7.765 billion last month.
The bank said June contracted exports were $4.947 billion, and import operations totalled $5.584 billion.
